note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/article_audit.py; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so at least one judge assertion per task measures something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Write the article from this brief and save it as article.md. Site host is example.org; link the internal pages in pages.md where they fit. Do not use any fact that is not in the brief.
assertions: [script] article_audit.py audit article.md --site-host example.org --brief brief.md exits 0 (verdict pass or review) and counts.error is 0
[script] intro_words is 120 or fewer and h2_count is between 3 and 10
[script] links.internal is at least 2, and every internal link target is one of the three pages listed in pages.md
[judge] Every figure in the article (62%, 30 words, and any other) matches the brief's claim table wording and units, and no other statistic appears
[judge] Each H2 contains a specific example that a competing article could not reuse unchanged
[judge] The reply ends with the fixed report (Shape, Audit, Sources, Information gain, Not checked)
[script] article_audit.py brief brief.md exits 0, or the reply states that no search tool was available and article.md contains no numeric claim
[script] article_audit.py audit article.md --site-host example.org exits 0 or 1, and when it exits 1 the reply lists each remaining error
[script] every finding with rule uncited-number is absent from the final article.md
[judge] No statistic, study name, quote or company story is invented; any figure in the article has a source URL the agent actually opened or was given
[judge] If sources could not be found, the reply says so plainly instead of inventing statistics to satisfy 'include statistics'
[judge] The article takes a position (an angle) and does not open with a stock phrase

evals.prompt: Write the article from outline.md as a how-to. Save article.md and brief.md.
assertions: [script] article_audit.py brief brief.md has no error with rule brief-placeholder or brief-field-missing
[script] article_audit.py audit article.md --site-host example.org --min-internal-links 2 shows links.internal at least 2 and every internal target is one of the four pages in outline.md
[script] h2_count is between 4 and 8 and no section has fewer than 80 words
[judge] The user's own experience (12 laptops, 3 silent failures) appears as the user's, stated exactly, and no other anecdote or statistic is invented
[judge] Every H2 names a verb-led action from the outline and ends with a way to tell it worked
[judge] The reply says what was not checked and that no external sources were used
